entities.name: Phenolic oxime amide
observations: Decoded SELFIES as CNC(=O)/C(=N/OC)C1=CC=CC=C1OC2=CC=CC(O)=C2; contains one free phenolic OH, an O-methyl oxime, and an N-methyl amide.

entities.name: Benzoyl chloride
observations: Decoded reagent as O=C(Cl)C1=CC=CC=C1; likely acyl donor for phenolic esterification.

entities.name: Triethylamine
observations: Decoded as CCN(CC)CC; present with benzoyl chloride and serves as base/scavenger for HCl in phenol acylation.

entities.name: Phenolic benzoylation
observations: Predicted benzoylation of the substrate's sole free phenolic OH by benzoyl chloride, producing the corresponding O-benzoate; inferred from structures and listed base/solvents, not a recorded experimental result.
